patch.value: Explain self-host refresh recovery for tracker-only PRs

PR #139 changes only tracker records and CHANGELOG.md but fails the committed self-host equality audit. Refresh its bundle without weakening verification. Recurring workflow proposal: when equality fails, print the exact recovery sequence: stage all intended tracker/source/docs changes explicitly, npm run changelog:full, stage CHANGELOG.md, npm run self-host:write, git add selfhost.bundle, commit, then npm run accept:self-host at HEAD. A future regression should prove a tracker-only commit fails with actionable guidance and passes after the committed refresh; verification must remain read-only.
PR #139 has a refreshed committed snapshot, targeted local acceptance and full CI evidence; contributor diagnostic proposal remains tracked for separate implementation.
